## Change

<!-- 1–2 sentences naming what changed, linking the key call sites. Note scope/safety: what's

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the new or changed behavior.
- [ ] Docs that the change makes stale are updated (READMEs, `docs/guide/`, `docs/reference/`).
- [ ] If the storage format changed: fixtures regenerated, both languages updated, and the spec updated (see [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/photon-grove/evt/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#storage-format-changes)).
- [ ] No credentials, account IDs, private hostnames or real data in code, docs or fixtures.
